ents.s: REMOVE ANY FOREIGN MATTER FROM TIMBER PILE
PRECOMPRESS PILE RADIALLY TO CLOSE ALL
INSTALL STEEL BAND THEN FILLET WELD CLOSE
WHILE APPLYING TENSION FROM A SECOND CHAIN
AND RATCHET WHICH IS TACK WELDED TO BAND.
